name: Wakoto Haruna
source:
A novice nurse at Kiyosato Hospital. Friendly and well-liked by both patients and staff. She's a late bloomer, and so is still a virgin.

[summarized from [url=http://slpr.sakura.ne.jp/RensaByo-toh/haruna.php]official site[/url]]
